concerns.text: Ensure generated DOCX schedule table covers all target groups (25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate students) with complete GOST R 7.0.97-2016 styling compliance.
Verify token expiration and rate limiting on 401 challenge endpoints to harden institutional PIN validation against automated brute-force attempts.
Verify responsiveness across both 375px mobile and 1440px desktop breakpoints to ensure strict visual fidelity to the approved mockup without regressions to existing components.
